headline: Egress routing change for private_b subnet will disrupt active connections
suppressed: The cost increase from a second NAT gateway (~$32/month + data processing) is documented in the PR description. The unused aws_route_table.private left behind is negligible cost (~$0.32/month).

findings.evidence_ref: aws_route_table_association.private_b changes route_table_id from aws_route_table.private.id to aws_route_table.private_b.id, plan shows update action
findings.explanation: Any instances currently running in the private_b subnet will have their egress traffic redirected from NAT gateway A to NAT gateway B. Existing network connections will be reset and must reconnect through the new gateway, causing a momentary but notable service interruption.
